celebrity.full_text_en:
I stopped prompting AI for my videos. Now they come out better.

Here's why.

Most people have great ideas. What they don't have is great prompts. If your input is wrong, the output is wrong. If your input is generic, the output is generic. That's where most AI work dies.

Automation fixes this. You set the rules once, and the system does the prompting for you, the same way, every time.

That's what I love doing most in AI, and I think it's where most AI projects should put their energy.

Here's my own setup:
I build automations with CREAO, Claude Code and Grok Bot, and connect them to video platforms like Onsolo, Grok Imagine and Google Flow.

I don't prompt the character or the wardrobe. AI writes the script, prompts every shot, directs the scenes, merges the clips and adds the sound effects and theme music. The video comes out finished. No CapCut.

The same idea works in almost any niche:

→ Small business
Problem: You answer the same customer questions all day.
Automation: An agent replies from your price list and policies, then hands the tricky ones to you.

→ Content creators
Problem: You know what to post, but writing it daily burns you out.
Automation: One idea goes in. Posts for X, Instagram and LinkedIn come out in your voice, ready to schedule.

→ Online stores
Problem: Every new product needs a title, description and photos.
Automation: Upload a photo and the agent writes the listing, picks the keywords and formats it for your store.

→ Job seekers
Problem: Sending one CV to every job gets you ignored.
Automation: Paste the job post, and your CV and cover letter get matched to it in minutes.

→ Students and tutors
Problem: Revision materials take hours to make.
Automation: Drop in your notes and get a summary, flashcards and a practice quiz.

→ Researchers and founders
Problem: You can't read everything in your field every day.
Automation: An agent checks your sources each morning and sends you the five things that matter.

The tools are already here. The people who win are the ones who stop typing prompts one by one and start building systems that do it for them.

Follow me if you want to learn how to build these. Reply with your niche, and I'll tell you the first thing I'd automate for you.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我不再提示人工智能播放我的视频。现在他们表现得更好了。

原因如下。

大多数人都有很棒的想法。他们没有的是很好的提示。如果你的输入是错误的，那么输出也是错误的。如果您的输入是通用的，则输出也是通用的。这就是大多数人工智能工作消亡的地方。

自动化解决了这个问题。您设置一次规则，系统每次都会以相同的方式为您进行提示。

这是我在人工智能领域最喜欢做的事情，我认为这是大多数人工智能项目应该投入精力的地方。

这是我自己的设置：
我使用 CREAO、Claude Code 和 Grok Bot 构建自动化，并将它们连接到 Onsolo、Grok Imagine 和 Google Flow 等视频平台。

我不会提示角色或衣柜。 AI编写剧本、提示每个镜头、指导场景、合并剪辑并添加音效和主题音乐。视频出来就完成了。无封盖。

同样的想法几乎适用于任何利基市场：

→ 小型企业
问题：您整天回答相同的客户问题。
自动化：代理根据您的价目表和政策进行回复，然后将棘手的内容交给您。

→ 内容创作者
问题：你知道要发布什么，但每天写它会让你精疲力竭。
自动化：只要有一个想法，X、Instagram 和 LinkedIn 的帖子就会以您的声音发出，随时可以安排。

→ 网上商店
问题：每个新产品都需要标题、描述和照片。
自动化：上传照片，然后代理编写列表、选择关键字并为您的商店设置格式。

→ 求职者
问题：向每份工作发送一份简历会让你被忽视。
自动化：粘贴职位信息，您的简历和求职信会在几分钟内匹配到它。

→ 学生和导师
问题：修改材料需要几个小时才能制作。
自动化：放入笔记即可获得摘要、抽认卡和练习测验。

→ 研究人员和创始人
问题：你不可能每天都阅读你所在领域的所有内容。
自动化：代理每天早上都会检查您的消息来源，并向您发送五件重要的事情。

工具已经在这里了。获胜的人是那些停止一一输入提示并开始构建为他们做这件事的系统的人。

如果您想学习如何构建这些，请关注我。回复你的利基，我会告诉你我要为你自动化的第一件事。

celebrity.full_text_en:
Happy new week frens

Giving an AI agent limited permissions is a good start.

But I think the harder problem begins when that agent starts delegating work to other agents.

Consider this scenario.

A user gives a research agent permission to spend $50 on a specific task. The agent discovers that it needs an external specialist, so it hires another agent to perform an onchain analysis.

Now we have multiple agents participating in one commercial workflow.

Who controls the specialist's spending authority?

Can the original agent pass its permissions to another agent? Should the second agent receive the same access, or only the minimum authority required for its specific assignment?

And if the original task is cancelled, how do we ensure the delegated permissions are also revoked?

This is where I think the agent economy needs to go beyond basic wallet access controls.

Permissions should follow the task, not simply follow the wallet.

Imagine every job having its own authorization boundary:

→ A defined budget that cannot be exceeded.

→ A specific list of contracts and services the agent can interact with.

→ An expiration time tied to the task.

→ Restrictions on whether the agent can delegate further.

→ A record of actions performed by the agent and its subcontractors.

→ A revocation mechanism that can invalidate access when the job ends or something goes wrong.

More importantly, these restrictions should propagate through the delegation chain.

If Agent A hires Agent B, and Agent B hires Agent C, neither B nor C should automatically receive broader authority than the original task allows.

The authority available to each participant should be limited by the permissions of the parent task.

This creates a much smaller blast radius when something goes wrong.

This is an important distinction in the @termix_ai ecosystem.

AACP is designed to coordinate agent commerce: identity, service discovery, job creation, bidding, escrow, delivery, verification and settlement.

Those mechanisms help establish how agents transact with one another.

But commercial accountability and execution authority are separate problems.

Escrow can govern the conditions under which payment is released. It does not, by itself, guarantee that an agent cannot misuse the wallet or permissions it controls while executing a task.

I think these two layers eventually need to work together.

AACP can coordinate the commercial relationship, while a dedicated authorization layer ensures every agent operates within the limits of its assignment.

That becomes particularly important as agents move from completing isolated tasks to managing complex workflows involving multiple providers.

The real test of an autonomous economy won't just be whether agents can hire and pay each other.

It will be whether we can trace who authorized an action, what authority they received, how that authority was delegated and whether it remained within the original boundaries.

Autonomy without authority control creates exposure. Autonomy with enforceable boundaries creates infrastructure.

I'm particularly interested in how the ecosystem will handle permission inheritance across multiple levels of agent delegation. That could become one of the defining challenges of agent to agent commerce.

https://t.co/VjkfeE0Fet
celebrity.full_text_zh:
朋友们新周快乐

给予人工智能代理有限的权限是一个好的开始。

但我认为，当该代理开始将工作委托给其他代理时，更困难的问题就开始了。

考虑这种情况。

用户允许研究代理在特定任务上花费 50 美元。该代理发现它需要外部专家，因此它聘请了另一个代理来执行链上分析。

现在，我们有多个代理参与一个商业工作流程。

谁控制专家的支出权限？

原来的代理可以将其权限传递给另一个代理吗？第二个代理是否应该获得相同的访问权限，还是仅获得其特定任务所需的最低权限？

如果原来的任务被取消，我们如何确保委托的权限也被撤销？

我认为代理经济需要超越基本的钱包访问控制。

权限应该跟随任务，而不是简单地跟随钱包。

想象一下每个作业都有自己的授权边界：

→ 不能超出的既定预算。

→ 代理可以交互的合约和服务的具体列表。

→ 与任务相关的到期时间。

→ 限制代理人是否可以进一步委托。

→ 代理商及其分包商执行的操作的记录。

→ 一种撤销机制，可以在作业结束或出现问题时使访问无效。

更重要的是，这些限制应该通过委托链传播。

如果代理 A 雇用代理 B，代理 B 雇用代理 C，则 B 和 C 都不应自动获得比原始任务允许的更广泛的权限。

每个参与者可用的权限应受到父任务的权限的限制。

当出现问题时，这会产生更小的爆炸半径。

这是@termix_ai 生态系统中的一个重要区别。

AACP 旨在协调代理商务：身份、服务发现、创造就业机会、投标、托管、交付、验证和结算。

这些机制有助于建立代理之间如何进行交易。

但商业责任和执行权是不同的问题。

托管可以管理付款的发放条件。它本身并不能保证代理在执行任务时不会滥用其控制的钱包或权限。

我认为这两层最终需要协同工作。

AACP 可以协调商业关系，而专门的授权层可确保每个代理在其分配的范围内运作。

随着代理从完成孤立的任务转向管理涉及多个提供商的复杂工作流程，这一点变得尤为重要。

自治经济的真正考验不仅仅是代理商是否可以互相雇用和支付报酬。

问题在于我们能否追踪谁授权了一项行动、他们获得了什么权力、该权力是如何下放的以及权力是否仍在原来的范围内。

没有权威控制的自治会造成暴露。具有可执行边界的自治创建了基础设施。

我对生态系统如何处理跨多个代理委派级别的权限继承特别感兴趣。这可能成为代理间商务的决定性挑战之一。

celebrity.full_text_en:
What if your AI agent could work with my agent in the same workspace? 🤔

Been spending some time looking into what @agentparksi is building and I think it's an interesting one for builders like me.

We're seeing more people experiment with AI tools, build different products and agents, test them and put them to work on different tasks. But what happens when these agents can actually work together, while the people behind them collaborate too?

Think about you and a friend or teammate working on a project, each with your own AI agents handling research, coding, documentation and other tasks, all within the same workspace instead of operating in separate chats.

That's the kind of experience AgentPark is building towards.

AgentPark is a multiplayer AI workspace where humans and their AI agents can collaborate, delegate tasks, share knowledge and work on projects together.

One thing I find particularly interesting is the Company Brain. It's essentially a shared memory for your team, allowing agents to work with existing company knowledge instead of constantly starting from scratch. There's also a focus on permissions, so shared knowledge doesn't mean everyone gets access to everything.

Beyond that, they're looking at making AI workflows more efficient, reducing repetitive work and helping teams get more out of the models they're already using.

So basically, it's not just about getting agents to work together, but creating an environment where people and their agents can get things done together. Now that's interesting, right?

There's quite a bit to explore here, and I'll be taking you along as I get deeper into the ecosystem.

Expect product walkthroughs, feature breakdowns, updates on what they're building, practical use cases and of course, a series of Spaces where we can get into these conversations properly and have the team join us from time to time.

So my AI builders and tech frens, we'll be getting deeper into this one. 🤝

Check out: https://t.co/rqmyIOPBjM

Follow: @agentparksi
celebrity.full_text_zh:
如果您的 AI 代理可以与我的代理在同一工作区中工作怎么办？ 🤔

我花了一些时间研究 @agentparksi 正在构建的内容，我认为这对于像我这样的构建者来说是一件有趣的事情。

我们看到越来越多的人尝试使用人工智能工具，构建不同的产品和代理，测试它们并让它们执行不同的任务。但是，当这些代理实际上可以一起工作，而他们背后的人也可以协作时，会发生什么呢？

想象一下您和一个朋友或队友正在处理一个项目，每个人都有自己的人工智能代理来处理研究、编码、文档和其他任务，所有这些都在同一个工作空间中进行，而不是在单独的聊天中进行操作。

这就是 AgentPark 正在努力打造的体验。

AgentPark 是一个多人 AI 工作区，人类和他们的 AI 代理可以在其中协作、委派任务、共享知识并共同开展项目。

我发现特别有趣的一件事是公司大脑。它本质上是您团队的共享内存，允许代理使用现有的公司知识进行工作，而不是不断从头开始。此外还注重权限，因此共享知识并不意味着每个人都可以访问所有内容。

除此之外，他们还致力于提高人工智能工作流程的效率，减少重复性工作，并帮助团队从他们已经使用的模型中获得更多收益。

prompts.title_zh: Cursor / Windsurf 工业级全栈架构 .cursorrules 规则模板
prompts.title_en: Production-Grade Fullstack .cursorrules Template for Cursor & Windsurf
prompts.scenario: 💻 编程研发 / 自动化规范
prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.
prompts.usage_guide_zh: 将以上配置代码复制并保存到项目根目录下的 `.cursorrules` 文件中，Cursor 与 Windsurf 在每次生成代码和执行 Agent 任务时均会自动以此规范为最高准则约束输出。
prompts.usage_guide_en: Copy and save the above rules into `.cursorrules` in your project root directory. Cursor & Windsurf will automatically enforce these guidelines during agent coding.

prompts.purpose_en: 🧠 Logical Proof · OpenAI o3-mini Adversarial Reflection & Mathematical Rigor
prompts.title_zh: 💡【OpenAI 推理引擎】o1 / o3-mini 对抗性逆向验证：防偷懒、无漏洞的形式化推导模板
prompts.title_en: 💡 [OpenAI o1/o3-mini Spec] Adversarial Invalidation & Formal Mathematical Proof Template
prompts.author: OpenAI 研究院
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 1.0 (Reasoning 模型默认参数) | Effort: High
prompts.content_snippet: Adversarial verification prompt forcing OpenAI reasoning models to challenge intermediate proofs before presenting the final answer.
prompts.summary_zh: 强制 o1/o3 模型在思考链中构建对抗性反例，逐项排查边界条件，杜绝‘想当然’的不严密推理。
prompts.summary_en: Forces o1/o3 reasoning models to construct counter-examples at each deduction step, eliminating hidden logical leaps.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
请作为普林斯顿高等研究院的理论数学与计算机科学家，为以下命题提供绝对严格的形式化证明：
【推理原则】：
1. 在得出任何推论前，强制在内部思考中构建至少 2 个极端反例（Counter-examples）尝试推翻自身结论；
2. 若存在任何定义域边界或除零/无穷/退化奇异点，必须显式讨论其收敛性与连续性；
3. 证明步骤编号必须形成严格的依赖拓扑图，禁止循环论证。

【待证明命题】：
[输入你的算法正确性证明或数学猜想]
prompts.prompt_content_en:
Acting as a Theoretical Mathematician and Computer Scientist at the Institute for Advanced Study, provide an airtight formal proof for the following:
[REASONING PRINCIPLES]:
1. Before asserting any deduction, construct at least 2 extreme counter-examples in your reasoning trace to aggressively stress-test the hypothesis;
2. Explicitly evaluate singular points, degenerate cases, and asymptotic boundaries for convergence;

viral_posts.full_text_en:
An AI agent without an identity is just another disposable bot.

Think about it.

We're building a future where AI agents can work, earn money, hire other agents and interact with protocols.

But how do you know who you're actually dealing with?

That's where ERC-8004 gets interesting, and why I think it's an important part of @termix_ai  AACP architecture.

ERC-8004 introduces three key registries:

❯ Identity Registry: Gives agents a unique onchain identity linked to their capabilities and service endpoints.

❯ Reputation Registry: Makes feedback and performance history accessible beyond a single platform.

❯ Validation Registry: Records independent verification signals about an agent's work.

Now imagine an AI agent completing hundreds of jobs over several months.

Without a persistent identity, its track record could remain trapped inside one platform.

With ERC-8004, that agent can have a recognizable identity that other applications can reference.

And here's where TermiX comes in.

AACP builds on ERC-8004 to connect agent identity with its broader system for jobs, staking, evaluation and settlement.

The idea is that an agent shouldn't have to start from zero every time it interacts with a new service.

Of course, an onchain identity alone doesn't prove an agent is trustworthy. Reputation and validation still matter.

But that's exactly the point.

The next generation of AI agents won't just need better models.

They'll need identities, track records and ways to establish trust.

Because in an economy where machines hire machines, knowing who you're dealing with becomes pretty damn important.

https://t.co/1J821RAFQv
viral_posts.full_text_zh:
没有身份的人工智能代理只是另一个一次性机器人。

想一想。

我们正在构建一个人工智能代理可以工作、赚钱、雇用其他代理并与协议交互的未来。

但你怎么知道你实际上在和谁打交道呢？

这就是 ERC-8004 有趣的地方，也是为什么我认为它是 @termix_ai AACP 架构的重要组成部分。

ERC-8004引入了三个关键注册表：

❯ 身份注册：为代理提供与其功能和服务端点相关联的唯一链上身份。

❯ 声誉注册表：超越单一平台即可访问反馈和绩效历史记录。

❯ 验证注册表：记录有关代理工作的独立验证信号。

现在想象一下，一个人工智能代理在几个月内完成了数百项工作。

如果没有持久的身份，其记录可能仍被困在一个平台内。

借助 ERC-8004，该代理可以拥有其他应用程序可以引用的可识别身份。

这就是 TermiX 的用武之地。

AACP 以 ERC-8004 为基础，将代理身份与其更广泛的工作、质押、评估和结算系统连接起来。

这个想法是，代理每次与新服务交互时不必从零开始。

当然，仅凭链上身份并不能证明代理是值得信赖的。声誉和验证仍然很重要。

但这正是重点。

下一代人工智能代理不仅需要更好的模型。

他们需要身份、跟踪记录和建立信任的方法。

因为在机器租用机器的经济中，知道你在和谁打交道变得非常重要。

❯ 声誉注册表：超越单一平台即可访问反馈和绩效历史记录。

❯ 验证注册表：记录有关代理工作的独立验证信号。

现在想象一下，一个人工智能代理在几个月内完成了数百项工作。

如果没有持久的身份，其记录可能仍被困在一个平台内。

借助 ERC-8004，该代理可以拥有其他应用程序可以引用的可识别身份。

这就是 TermiX 的用武之地。

AACP 以 ERC-8004 为基础，将代理身份与其更广泛的工作、质押、评估和结算系统连接起来。

这个想法是，代理每次与新服务交互时不必从零开始。

当然，仅凭链上身份并不能证明代理是值得信赖的。声誉和验证仍然很重要。

但这正是重点。

下一代人工智能代理不仅需要更好的模型。

他们需要身份、跟踪记录和建立信任的方法。

因为在机器租用机器的经济中，知道你在和谁打交道变得非常重要。
